review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Auntie Edna has seen seventy-four years of ups and downs, and she has a word for each: thrilled and devastated, ashamed and resentful, nostalgic, hopeful or reluctant, and what cheers you up.
description.sl: Teta Edna je videla štiriinsedemdeset let vzponov in padcev in ima besedo za vsakega: vzhičen in strt, osramočen in zamerljiv, nostalgičen, poln upanja ali nenaklonjen ter kaj te razvedri.
description.it: Zia Edna ha visto settantaquattro anni di alti e bassi e ha una parola per ciascuno: entusiasta e distrutto, che si vergogna e risentito, nostalgico, fiducioso o riluttante, e che cosa ti tira su di morale.
description.de: Tante Edna hat vierundsiebzig Jahre Höhen und Tiefen erlebt und hat für jedes ein Wort: begeistert und am Boden zerstört, beschämt und nachtragend, nostalgisch, hoffnungsvoll oder widerwillig, und was einen aufmuntert.

words.example_en: She was anxious about the results, although she tried not to show it.
words.example_sl: Zaradi izvidov je bila tesnobna, čeprav je skušala tega ne pokazati.
words.example_it: Era ansiosa per i risultati, anche se cercava di non darlo a vedere.
words.example_de: Sie war wegen der Ergebnisse beunruhigt, obwohl sie es nicht zeigen wollte.
words.note: Anxious about something is worried; anxious to do something is wanting it very much.
words.note_sl: Anxious about je zaskrbljen; anxious to do pomeni zelo želeti.
words.note_it: Anxious about è preoccupato; anxious to do vuol dire desiderare molto.
words.note_de: Anxious about heißt besorgt; anxious to do heißt etwas unbedingt wollen.

words.example_en: He gets frustrated when the broadband keeps cutting out.
words.example_sl: Frustriran je, ko širokopasovna povezava kar naprej izpada.
words.example_it: Si sente frustrato quando la connessione continua a cadere.
words.example_de: Er ist frustriert, wenn das Internet ständig ausfällt.

words.example_en: With forty guests and two staff off sick, Mrs Birkett felt overwhelmed.
words.example_sl: S štiridesetimi gosti in dvema bolnima zaposlenima se je gospa Birkett počutila preobremenjeno.
words.example_it: Con quaranta ospiti e due dipendenti malati, la signora Birkett si sentiva sopraffatta.
words.example_de: Mit vierzig Gästen und zwei kranken Angestellten war Mrs Birkett überfordert.
words.note: Overwhelmed is also by good things: overwhelmed by everyone's kindness.
words.note_sl: Overwhelmed je lahko tudi od lepega: overwhelmed by everyone's kindness (ganjen).
words.note_it: Overwhelmed anche per cose belle: overwhelmed by everyone's kindness (commosso).
words.note_de: Overwhelmed auch von Schönem: overwhelmed by everyone's kindness (überwältigt).

words.example_en: Jack was thrilled to bits when his ram won first prize.
words.example_sl: Jack je bil ves vzhičen, ko je njegov oven dobil prvo nagrado.
words.example_it: Jack era entusiasta quando il suo montone ha vinto il primo premio.
words.example_de: Jack war total begeistert, als sein Widder den ersten Preis gewann.
words.note: Thrilled to bits is a very British way of saying very happy.
words.note_sl: Thrilled to bits je zelo britanski izraz za presrečen.
words.note_it: Thrilled to bits è un modo molto britannico per dire felicissimo.
words.note_de: Thrilled to bits ist sehr britisch für überglücklich.

words.example_en: We would be delighted if you could join us for dinner.
words.example_sl: Presrečni bi bili, če bi se nam pridružili na večerji.
words.example_it: Saremmo felicissimi se poteste unirvi a noi per cena.
words.example_de: Wir würden uns sehr freuen, wenn Sie zum Abendessen kommen könnten.
words.note: Delighted is a little formal: in letters and invitations.
words.note_sl: Delighted je nekoliko formalno: v pismih in vabilih.
words.note_it: Delighted è un po' formale: nelle lettere e negli inviti.
words.note_de: Delighted ist etwas förmlich: in Briefen und Einladungen.

words.example_en: The family were devastated when the flood destroyed their farm.
words.example_sl: Družina je bila strta, ko je poplava uničila njihovo kmetijo.
words.example_it: La famiglia era distrutta quando l'alluvione ha rovinato la loro fattoria.
words.example_de: Die Familie war am Boden zerstört, als das Hochwasser ihren Hof verwüstete.

words.example_en: He was ashamed of what he had said and apologised the next day.
words.example_sl: Sram ga je bilo, kar je rekel, in naslednji dan se je opravičil.
words.example_it: Si vergognava di quello che aveva detto e il giorno dopo si è scusato.
words.example_de: Er schämte sich für das, was er gesagt hatte, und entschuldigte sich am nächsten Tag.
words.note: Ashamed is about something wrong you did; embarrassed is about something silly that happened.
words.note_sl: Ashamed je zaradi nečesa slabega, kar si storil; embarrassed zaradi nerodnosti.
words.note_it: Ashamed è per qualcosa di sbagliato che hai fatto; embarrassed per una figuraccia.
words.note_de: Ashamed ist man wegen eines Unrechts; embarrassed wegen einer Peinlichkeit.

words.example_en: She felt insecure in her new job until people got to know her.
words.example_sl: V novi službi se je počutila negotovo, dokler je ljudje niso spoznali.
words.example_it: Nel nuovo lavoro si sentiva insicura finché la gente non l'ha conosciuta.
words.example_de: Im neuen Job war sie unsicher, bis die Leute sie kennengelernt hatten.

words.example_en: He's still resentful that his brother got the farm.
words.example_sl: Še vedno zameri, da je kmetijo dobil brat.
words.example_it: È ancora risentito perché la fattoria è andata a suo fratello.
words.example_de: Er ist immer noch verbittert, dass sein Bruder den Hof bekommen hat.

words.example_en: Wilf is content with a quiet life under the oak.
words.example_sl: Wilf je zadovoljen z mirnim življenjem pod hrastom.
words.example_it: Wilf è appagato da una vita tranquilla sotto la quercia.
words.example_de: Wilf ist mit einem ruhigen Leben unter der Eiche zufrieden.
words.note: The adjective is said con-TENT; the noun content (what is inside) is CON-tent.
words.note_sl: Pridevnik se naglasi con-TENT; samostalnik content (vsebina) pa CON-tent.
words.note_it: L'aggettivo si dice con-TENT; il nome content (contenuto) CON-tent.
words.note_de: Das Adjektiv heißt con-TENT; das Nomen content (Inhalt) CON-tent.

words.example_en: Teenagers can be moody, says Maggie, and so can the weather.
words.example_sl: Najstniki so lahko muhasti, pravi Maggie, in vreme tudi.
words.example_it: Gli adolescenti possono essere lunatici, dice Maggie, e anche il tempo.
words.example_de: Teenager können launisch sein, sagt Maggie, und das Wetter auch.

words.example_en: Poppy was heartbroken when her old cat died.
words.example_sl: Poppy je bila strtega srca, ko ji je umrl stari muc.
words.example_it: Poppy aveva il cuore spezzato quando è morto il suo vecchio gatto.
words.example_de: Poppy war todunglücklich, als ihre alte Katze starb.

words.example_en: The old songs on the radio make Edna nostalgic.
words.example_sl: Stare pesmi na radiu Edno navdajo z nostalgijo.
words.example_it: Le vecchie canzoni alla radio rendono Edna nostalgica.
words.example_de: Die alten Lieder im Radio machen Edna nostalgisch.

words.example_en: After the doctor's news, the whole family felt more hopeful.
words.example_sl: Po zdravnikovi novici je bila vsa družina bolj polna upanja.
words.example_it: Dopo la notizia del medico tutta la famiglia era più fiduciosa.
words.example_de: Nach der Nachricht des Arztes war die ganze Familie hoffnungsvoller.

words.example_en: By the third day without water, the campers were desperate.
words.example_sl: Tretji dan brez vode so bili kampisti obupani.
words.example_it: Al terzo giorno senza acqua i campeggiatori erano disperati.
words.example_de: Am dritten Tag ohne Wasser waren die Camper verzweifelt.
words.note: Desperate for something is wanting it very much: I'm desperate for a cup of tea.
words.note_sl: Desperate for something pomeni nekaj zelo potrebovati: I'm desperate for a cup of tea.
words.note_it: Desperate for something è averne un gran bisogno: I'm desperate for a cup of tea.
words.note_de: Desperate for something heißt etwas dringend brauchen: I'm desperate for a cup of tea.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson was furious when someone let his dog chase the sheep.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson je bil besen, ko je nekdo pustil psa, da je preganjal ovce.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson era furioso quando qualcuno ha lasciato che il cane inseguisse le pecore.
words.example_de: Mr Tyson war wütend, als jemand seinen Hund die Schafe jagen ließ.

words.example_en: Everyone was astonished that Edna had climbed Helvellyn at seventy.
words.example_sl: Vsi so bili osupli, da je Edna pri sedemdesetih splezala na Helvellyn.
words.example_it: Tutti erano stupiti che Edna fosse salita sull'Helvellyn a settant'anni.
words.example_de: Alle waren erstaunt, dass Edna mit siebzig auf den Helvellyn gestiegen war.

words.example_en: The tourists looked puzzled when Jack said "Now then!".
words.example_sl: Turisti so bili videti zbegani, ko je Jack rekel »Now then!«.
words.example_it: I turisti sembravano perplessi quando Jack ha detto «Now then!».
words.example_de: Die Touristen schauten verdutzt, als Jack »Now then!« sagte.

words.example_en: The new apprentice is keen to learn everything at once.
words.example_sl: Novi vajenec je željan, da bi se naučil vsega naenkrat.
words.example_it: Il nuovo apprendista è desideroso di imparare tutto subito.
words.example_de: Der neue Lehrling ist erpicht darauf, alles auf einmal zu lernen.
words.note: Keen to do, keen on something: I'm not keen on fish (I don't like it much).
words.note_sl: Keen to do, keen on something: I'm not keen on fish (ribe nimam ravno rad).
words.note_it: Keen to do, keen on something: I'm not keen on fish (il pesce non mi entusiasma).
words.note_de: Keen to do, keen on something: I'm not keen on fish (Fisch mag ich nicht besonders).

words.example_en: He was reluctant to sell the farm his grandfather had built.
words.example_sl: Ni bil naklonjen prodaji kmetije, ki jo je zgradil njegov ded.
words.example_it: Era riluttante a vendere la fattoria costruita da suo nonno.
words.example_de: Er wollte den Hof, den sein Großvater gebaut hatte, nur widerwillig verkaufen.

words.example_en: What a relief: the helicopter has found them!
words.example_sl: Kakšno olajšanje: helikopter jih je našel!
words.example_it: Che sollievo: l'elicottero li ha trovati!
words.example_de: Was für eine Erleichterung: Der Hubschrauber hat sie gefunden!

words.example_en: Her only regret is that she didn't learn to swim.
words.example_sl: Edino obžaluje, da se ni naučila plavati.
words.example_it: Il suo unico rimpianto è non aver imparato a nuotare.
words.example_de: Sie bedauert nur, dass sie nicht schwimmen gelernt hat.
words.note: Regret is also a verb: I regret selling the house (I wish I hadn't).
words.note_sl: Regret je tudi glagol: I regret selling the house (žal mi je, da sem jo prodal).
words.note_it: Regret è anche un verbo: I regret selling the house (mi pento di averla venduta).
words.note_de: Regret ist auch ein Verb: I regret selling the house (ich bereue es).

words.example_en: Her garden is the envy of the whole village.
words.example_sl: Njen vrt je v zavist vsej vasi.
words.example_it: Il suo giardino è l'invidia di tutto il paese.
words.example_de: Ihr Garten wird vom ganzen Dorf beneidet.
words.note_sl: Green with envy: zelen od zavisti.
words.note_de: Green with envy: grün vor Neid.

words.example_en: A cup of tea and a scone always cheer Edna up.
words.example_sl: Skodelica čaja in pogača Edno vedno razvedrita.
words.example_it: Una tazza di tè e uno scone tirano sempre su di morale Edna.
words.example_de: Eine Tasse Tee und ein Scone muntern Edna immer auf.
words.note: Cheer up! says: don't be sad.
words.note_sl: Cheer up! pomeni: ne bodi žalosten.
words.note_it: Cheer up! vuol dire: su con la vita.
